units: SD of normalized school value added

method.estimand: Expected empirical distribution of families' treatment-conditional expected school VA, averaged over randomized treatment assignment within the selected group.
method.mixture: For eligible families, the untreated potential expected-VA observation receives weight 1-tau and the treated potential expected-VA observation receives weight tau. Ineligible families retain untreated weight 1.
method.distinction: This averages distributions over treatment assignment; it is not the distribution of each family's ex-ante interpolated expected VA, and is not a realized finite assignment draw.
method.weighting: Each of the 815 experimental families has total weight one. SEP and non-SEP groups are 505 and 310 families.
method.density: Gaussian KDE, baseline-only robust normal-reference bandwidth per displayed group, fixed across policies; 8-bandwidth cutoff. Same underlying outcomes as paper, separately declared web smoothing.
method.cdf: Exact weighted empirical CDF at each exported x threshold, including ties.
method.quantiles: Smallest observed expected-VA value whose weighted empirical CDF is at least p; computed from weighted potential observations, never interpolated from endpoint quantiles.
method.scope: Demand only: school quality, prices and menus held fixed; no capacity assignment or school supply response. No population extrapolation or coefficient sensitivity.
